narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Logical Argument -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers, particularly parents, about the inherent biases in media and social algorithms. It uses an energetic and professional presentation style to explain why absolute objectivity is impossible and provides a practical tip: cross-referencing multiple sources to build independent critical thinking skills.
